title: Surrey Happy Hour (Local Menu Search Platform)
highlights: Built and deployed a local search platform covering 2,300+ menu items across 100+ Surrey restaurants.
Implemented search and ranking based on menu price and current happy-hour availability.
Developed structured data-ingestion and admin-review workflows for maintaining restaurant and menu information.
Containerized and deployed the application on Oracle Cloud using Docker and Caddy.

title: UnSigned (Anonymous Messaging Platform)
highlights: Built a platform where users can share personalized links and receive anonymous feedback and messages.
Developed a customizable admin dashboard with user-management and moderation controls.
Added customizable UI options and multi-language support.
Deployed the application publicly at UnSigned.ca using Oracle Cloud.

title: Minimal YTube (Chrome Extension)
highlights: Built a Chrome extension that removes non-essential elements from YouTube pages.
Designed the experience to keep users focused on the currently playing video.
Created a minimal viewing interface that reduces visual distractions.
